purpose: Nontraining timing diagnosis, never official qualification
round_order: Alternate base order and reversed base order within every phase
batch: First 32 frozen training tasks in manifest order
summary_policy: All samples; mean, median, sample standard deviation, p90, p95, min, max; never choose fastest
percentile: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*q; within each worker and pooled with order strata
diagnosis_policy: Cold-start support only if all four workers show cold above warm median for both models, all warmed p95 projections <=720, and all process peaks <=4 GiB; otherwise unresolved or resource NO_GO; never change official result
